dynamicDef.Electromagnetic: Each person carries one gate of the channel; the channel is completed only when the two are together.
dynamicDef.Dominance: One person carries both gates of the channel and the other carries neither; one-directional conditioning.
dynamicDef.Compromise: One person carries both gates of the channel; the other carries only one (hanging) gate of it.
dynamicDef.Companionship: Both people carry both gates of the channel in their own charts; a shared, familiar frequency.

pentaPositionDef.upper: Runs from the G Center to the Throat; leadership and the roles through which the group presents itself.
pentaPositionDef.lower: Runs from the G Center to the Sacral; the managed, productive and resource roles.

note.pentaCore: The 2/14 Channel of the Beat is the material core of the Penta: gate 2 is the direction of resources, gate 14 the resources themselves.
note.pentaGap: A gate that no member carries shows a missing function (role gap) that the group tries to compensate for.
note.disclaimer: This analysis shows the mechanics of the Human Design system; it is not a scientifically validated relationship prediction, compatibility score or guarantee of success.
